utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: What’s the main thing you need from me for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just confirming — the repair drive is still on, right? Do you need more people, or is timing the bigger issue?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, it’s still on. I mostly need more people — timing’s flexible.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late — I can help sort the donated tools and label the boxes. Where should I start?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Start with the tool table by the garage, then label the boxes as you sort. If you can, please check for any paint and patch supplies too.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I’ll start at the tool table by the garage and check for paint and patch supplies too.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Oren—I’ll double-check the flyer for the exact time and repair list, then we can compare notes.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sounds good, Hana—thanks. I’ll keep an eye out in my shed and bring over whatever I find.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Great, thanks, Oren. I’ll check the flyer and compare notes once I have the exact time and repair list.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Rey — the repair drive is this Sunday at the community center now. Let me know if you can help spread the word or bring anything by.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help spread the word and I can bring some small tools or duct tape too. Just let me know what’s most needed.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That would be wonderful, Rey—please spread the word, and small tools plus duct tape would be really helpful. I’ll keep you posted if anything else comes up.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Sure — if you hear any updates, just pass them along and I’ll share them around the block. What do you need me to tell people about the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Nell. Please tell folks it’s this Sunday at the community center, and they can bring tools or spare parts if they have them.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it — this Sunday at the community center, and I’ll mention tools or spare parts are welcome. I’ll pass it along to the neighbors.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing, Opal — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to bring or do?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Sam — please help spread the word and be ready to sort donations at Maple Hall on 3rd Street, Saturday from 10 to 2. I’ll send you the route and stop count as soon as I have the latest list.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, Opal — I’ll spread the word and be ready to sort donations at Maple Hall Saturday from 10 to 2. Just send the route and stop count when you have them.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — I must’ve missed the latest details on the repair drive. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Mainly just spreading the word now — it moved to Sunday at the community center, so more people would help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it — I’ll spread the word. Sunday at the community center, right?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, it’s been a busy one already—folks are really turning out for the repair drive. I’ll keep you posted if I hear anything useful.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Tess — I can help with school pickup and drop-off timing if that’s useful. Just keep me posted on anything the repair drive still needs.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that’d be really helpful, Faye—thank you. I’ll let you know if I hear anything the repair drive still needs.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great—so who’s covering the other two stops, and when do you need me to help?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ve got the first stop, and Sam said he can cover one of the others. If you can take the last one, that’d be perfect — I’ll send you the route now.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sounds good — send me the route and I’ll cover the last stop.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I can keep spreading the word and point people toward the repair drive supplies. What needs the most help right now?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Jules — spreading the word and pointing folks to supplies is exactly what helps most right now. I’m still waiting on the route and stop count, but I’ll share them as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Got it — I’ll keep folks posted and point them to the supplies in the meantime. Just send the route and stop count when you have them.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I still need the route and total stops before I can say whether the schedule makes sense. How many stops are we planning in all?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I don’t have the final stop count yet, Pia — I’m still gathering that. I’ll keep spreading the word about the repair drive and the paint and patch supplies later.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Okay, but please send the route and final stop count as soon as you have them—I need that to check the drive time and staffing.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: If you can help track down the screws, duct tape, and small tools first, that would really help. I’ll keep on with the rest as best I can.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Absolutely—I’ll track down the screws, duct tape, and small tools. And just to note, the repair drive is Sunday at the community center now.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Cleo—that helps a lot. I’ll keep pushing the rest and make sure we’re set for Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: What’s the latest on the repair drive? I can bring something or help out if needed.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Noah — the big priorities are the loose fence by the mailbox and the broken step near the community room. If you can bring a few tools or help point people to the supplies, that’d be great.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it — I can bring a few tools and help point folks to the supplies. I’ll start with the fence by the mailbox and the broken step near the community room.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, sounds like there’s already a good turnout, Bo. I’ll keep my ears open and let you know if I hear anything useful about the drive.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Tess — just flag anything urgent you hear about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, will do, Bo — if anything urgent comes up, I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, the repair drive is still on, right?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late — what part of the repair drive needs the most help?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Yes — just confirming it’s still on. Right now it seems like lining up a few more people is the main need.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Sounds good, Gus — I’ll keep passing along the word, too. Hopefully we can get a nice turnout and a few extra supplies for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Nell — I appreciate you spreading the word. If you hear of anyone with spare tools or supplies, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Will do, Gus — I’ll keep an ear out and pass along anyone who can help with tools or supplies.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—I’ll spread the word and keep you in the loop on the repair drive. If you want, I can also add you to the list of people helping out.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Quinn — that’d be great. I’ll keep spreading the word about the repair drive and the paint and patch supplies later.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, Vik — I’ll add you to the list and keep the repair drive updates coming. Thanks for helping spread the word!

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard it’s mainly the fence panels and that broken step, but I’ll check for any other updates while I’m out.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Okay, but how many stops are we planning in total? I still need the full route before I can plan the drive time.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m not sure on the total yet, but I’ll ask around and see if there’s a full route update.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Rosa — I’m still waiting on the final repair list and time, but I’ll send them over as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Mara — just send it over when you have it, and I’ll keep everyone updated on the Sunday community center plans.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Rosa — I appreciate that. I’ll send the repair list and time as soon as I get them.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Rey — I can use help spreading the word and sorting donations for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Absolutely — I can spread the word and help sort the donations. Just point me to where you want me to start.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great — start by sorting the donations by type, and I’ll tell a few more neighbors about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing, Eli — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to bring or do?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Sam. Just bring any tools, spare parts, or small items that need fixing this Sunday at the community center, and please help spread the word if you can.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll bring whatever tools and spare parts I can, and I’ll help spread the word too.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Opal—I still need the route and total stop count before I can judge the drive time. Once you have the latest list, please send it over so I can check staffing.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Absolutely — I’ll send the route and total stop count as soon as I get the latest list.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Opal. Once you have it, please send the route and stop count so I can check the drive time and staffing.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I haven’t seen the repair-drive details yet—what exactly needs fixing, and when is it happening?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Rosa said it’s Sunday at the community center, and they’re keeping the details organized. I can help spread the word, but if you need specifics on what’s being fixed, I’d check with Rosa.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Faye — Sunday at the community center works for me. I’ll check with Rosa for the exact repair list so I can share it properly.
